summary.et: Hoiab UniFi U6-LR pääsupunkti pistikupesas ilma kruvideta.
summary.en: Holds a UniFi U6-LR access point on a wall socket, with no screws.

story.et: Üks prinditud detail läheb tavalisse Schuko pistikupessa. Pesa maandusklemmid hoiavad seda kinni, alumine tugipind toetub allpool oleva pesa kaanele ja võrgukaabel jookseb plaadi tagant küljele. Detailis pole metalli ega elektrilisi osi.
story.en: One printed part plugs into an ordinary Schuko socket. The socket's earth clips hold it, a pad rests on the cover of the socket below and the network cable leaves sideways behind the plate. The part has no metal and carries no power.

credit.et: Keeratava luku kuju on mõõdetud Peter H mudelilt, mis põhineb kasutaja magu mudelil. Mõlema litsents on CC BY-NC 4.0.
credit.en: The twist-lock profile is measured from a model by Peter H, which is based on a model by magu. Both are licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.

use.et: Hoiab meie UniFi U6-LR pääsupunkti seinal pistikupesas.
use.en: Holds our UniFi U6-LR access point on the wall, in a socket.

allowed_nonmanifold_reason.et: Neli serva, kus luku piiraja kohtub faasiga, puutuvad kokku piki üht joont. Just selline kuju prinditi.
allowed_nonmanifold_reason.en: Four edges where the twist-lock stop meets the chamfer touch along a line. This is the geometry that was printed.
